summary: Round aluminum mounting hub, a short disk with a central bore for a 3 mm motor shaft, four mounting holes on a circle around the bore, and one radial set-screw hole in the cylindrical side. The 2-pack includes two hubs, set screws and an Allen wrench; this describes a single hub.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat outer face with the four mounting holes, used to attach wheels or mechanisms
Opposite flat face, which seats against the gearmotor shaft side when the hub is mounted on the shaft

notes: No dimensions are printed in the images or listing, and the listing marks its dimensions as unverified. Only the 3 mm shaft/bore size is stated. The outer diameter, thickness, hole diameters, hole spacing and set-screw hole position are rough estimates scaled from the product photos against the 3 mm shaft. The four mounting holes are shown on the face but their depth is not visible, so they are marked not through. The set-screw hole sits on the cylindrical side, and its depth and exact position are estimated. Verify all values against the vendor drawing before using them in CAD.
